LESSON: IMITATIVE SPEAKING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.7: Imitative Speaking
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Imitative Speaking, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 4 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: how to take care of household items. 1. Why do we need various items in our homes? 2. How can we tell the position of an item in the house?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch visual recordings of various household items and identify them,

2. work collaboratively to discuss the uses of the various household items in homes,

3. locate positions of household items in relation to other items using prepositions (in, on, at, under, above)

4. demonstrate various positions of items in relation to others with peers,

5. listen to an audio recording and articulate target words correctly in pairs,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch visual recordings of various household items and identify them,
2. work collaboratively to discuss the uses of the various household items in homes,
3. locate positions of household items in relation to other items using prepositions (in, on, at, under, above)
4. demonstrate various positions of items in relation to others with peers,
5. listen to an audio recording and articulate target words correctly in pairs,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Imitative Speaking together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
